constraint.title: SSC1 Functional Mapping
constraint.description: This story implements a modernized Vaadin version of the SSC1 3270 terminal screen. The quick lookup panel must support SSC1 Option 1 workflow (Customer Inquiry: enter number/name → view record). Map to existing customer detail/edit stories for navigation targets.

constraint.title: Vaadin Grid Data Provider
constraint.description: Use lazy data provider pattern to efficiently handle pagination and large datasets. Grid should not load all customers at once. Implement ClientSortedProvider or ServerSortedProvider to delegate sort/filter to backend API.

constraint.title: Material Design 3 Styling
constraint.description: Follow Material Design 3 color palette and spacing standards. Status badge colors: ACTIVE=#4CAF50 (green), INACTIVE=#757575 (gray), buttons primary=#1976D2, secondary=#6C757D. Row height 56px, padding 16px, column spacing 8px.

constraint.title: Responsive Layout
constraint.description: Grid must collapse on mobile (<768px) to show only Name, Status, Actions columns. ID, Email, Phone hidden on mobile. Test on various breakpoints: phone (<480px), tablet (480-768px), desktop (>768px).

constraint.title: URL Query State
constraint.description: Search, filter, sort, and pagination state must be reflected in URL query parameters. URL: /customers/list?query={query}&status={status}&sort={field}&order={asc|desc}&page={n}&size={n}. Enable bookmarking and back-button support.

constraint.title: Accessibility WCAG 2.1 AA
constraint.description: All interactive elements require ARIA labels. Grid must be announced as table with proper headers. Keyboard navigation: Tab/Shift+Tab, Enter to select, Escape to close. Focus indicators must be visible (outline or highlight). Test with screen readers.

constraint.title: Delete Soft-Delete Confirmation
constraint.description: Delete action must show confirmation dialog with customer name and ID before calling API. Prevent accidental deletion. Confirmation dialog: "Are you sure you want to delete this customer? {Name (ID)}" with Cancel and Delete buttons.

constraint.title: Test Data Dependency
constraint.description: This story depends on Story 3-9 (Test Data Setup) for realistic testing. Coordinate to ensure test data is seeded before manual testing of this story's grid and search functionality.

interface.name: Customer Search API
interface.description: Primary API for loading customer grid data. Returns paginated results with total count for pagination controls. Supports search, filtering by status, sorting, and pagination.

interface.name: Customer Delete API
interface.description: Soft-delete API for customer records. Called after user confirms delete action in dialog. Returns 200 OK or 204 No Content on success, 404 if not found.

interface.name: Vaadin Router
interface.description: Navigation between pages: View button to /customers/{customerId}, Edit button to /customers/{customerId}?mode=edit. Lookup panel to detail page on found customer.

interface.name: Vaadin Grid
interface.description: Main data table component. Supports lazy loading, sorting, column resizing, inline actions. Populate with customer data from API using grid.setDataProvider(...).

tests.standards: Spring Boot integration tests using TestContainers for PostgreSQL. Vaadin component testing via TestBench or manual verification. API mocking with @MockBean for controller tests. UI behavior verified via manual testing with Vaadin application running. Responsive design tested on multiple breakpoints using browser dev tools or device simulation.
